notes.title: Version 1.8.3 - Major Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The long awaited update, is finally here! 

Most notably, there is a new character to enter the realm of Yin Yang!

### Features

* Added new character 'Reaper'
* Added 'Harvest' ability
* Added character selection
* Added characters tab, in gallery
* Improved boss health bar
* Separate moving and idle animations


### Bug Fixes & Balancing

* Chopper achievement requirements 100 -> 20
* Increased health of bosses
* Fixed slow time effect persisting between runs
* Fixed tutorial lasting longer due to new temples

notes.title: Version 1.8.2 - Regular Update
notes.content:
### Features

* Added new weapon temple. 
* Added the choice to destroy a temple instead of gaining the effects it provides.

### Balancing

* Increased boss health.

### Bug Fixes

* Decreased volume of Gong Sound effect.
* Reduced volume of Lightning's secondary effect.
* Popups now slowly appear one after another.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.4.4 The Controller Update
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 1.4.4 (2024-06-12)[/h1]

[h2]The controller update[/h2]
With this update, we improve the controller support, everything tested with a steam deck for now.
XBox and PS Controllers are on the way, 

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added an optional grid background, turn on in settings
[*]Added manual aim when using a controller's right joystick
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed A, B, X, Y steam deck buttons correctly mapped
[*] Fixed L2 and R2 not being mappable (8606f88)
[*] Made movement smoother when using a controller
[/list]

Known issues:
Sometimes the movement is a bit laggy when using a joystick, this is being worked on.
